create_MatplotlibUI: create a MatplotlibUI instance to visualize a Spriteworld environment with image and reward plots
run_setup_run_ui: run setup_run_ui to start an interactive demo loop with a human agent controlling a Spriteworld environment
create_HumanDragAndDropAgent: create a HumanDragAndDropAgent to interact with a Spriteworld environment via mouse clicks for drag-and-drop actions
create_HumanEmbodiedAgent: create a HumanEmbodiedAgent to interact with a Spriteworld environment via keyboard WASD keys and spacebar for carrying
test_MatplotlibUI_update: test the MatplotlibUI update method to render environment observations and track reward history over timesteps
